hypothesis: The existing candidate universe is heterogeneous. A causal SMC setup requiring a direction-matched 1H liquidity sweep, direction-appropriate 4H value location, and an order-block or FVG retest has better after-cost expectancy than trade-all and liquidity-sweep-only controls.

evidence_boundary.disclosure: The 2020-2026 period, BUY liquidity-sweep result, existing SMC components and prior model failures have influenced this design. A pass can only register a future shadow hypothesis and cannot establish an edge.

feature_only_preflight.reason: 4H structure defines candidate direction and both registered BOS presence fields are constant among historical candidates. Constant/gating fields cannot define useful subfamilies.

primitive_definitions.directional_value_zone: BUY and premium_discount_position <= 0.5, or SELL and premium_discount_position >= 0.5
primitive_definitions.multi_timeframe_alignment: structure_1d_encoded and structure_1h_encoded both equal +1 for BUY or -1 for SELL

evaluation_contract.target_semantics: 48 UTC-clock-hour direction-correct executable bid/ask TP/SL/expiry return with 0.10 points slippage per side
evaluation_contract.fold_semantics: Fixed rules require no fitting or calibration. Each calendar-year fold contains candidates assigned in that year whose actual label exit occurs before the next fold boundary; the final partial year uses only matured outcomes present in the frozen dataset.
evaluation_contract.primary_familywise_error_control: Two directional primary hypotheses use one-sided 97.5 percent lower bounds (alpha 0.025 per direction).

decision_rule.pass: A direction passes only if every registered primary gate passes. The result remains development-contaminated and may only create a new frozen prospective shadow variant.
decision_rule.fail: Preserve REJECT_CANDIDATE_GENERATION_V2 for the failed direction. Do not tune the rule from secondary diagnostics, create an ML artifact, change runtime approval, or change Telegram behavior.
decision_rule.mixed_direction_result: A passing direction never promotes the other direction.

change_rule: Any primitive, family expression, primary choice, target, cost, lifecycle, fold, comparator, uncertainty method, gate or direction rule change requires a new contract version before affected results are inspected.
